div.head: Af 18
div.ab: XVI. Gif hwa nunnan mid hæmedðinge oððe on hire hrægl oððe on hire breost buton hire leafe gefó, sy hit twybote swa we ær anfandlice be læwedum monnum fundon.
XVI. Gif hwa nunnan mid hæmeðþinge oððe on hire hrægl oððe on hire breost butan hire leafe gefó, sie hit twybete swa we ær be lǽwdum men fundon.
Si quis nunnam causa fornicationis in uestes aut in sinum sine licentia comprehendat, sit hoc duplo emendabile sicut ante simpliciter de laica decreuimus.
{XVI} Gif hwa nunnan mid hæmeðþinge oððe on hire hrægl oððe on hire breost butan hire leaf gefó, sie hit twybete swa we ær be læwdum men fundon.
If someone seizes a nun with carnal intent either on her clothing or on her breast without her permission, let the compensation be twice what we earlier set for lay[wo]men.
If anyone lustfully seizes a nun, either by her clothes or by her breast, without her permission, he shall pay as recompense twice the sum we have fixed in the case of a woman belonging to the laity.
If anyone in lewd fashion seizes a nun either by her clothes or her breast without her leave, the compensation is to be double that we have established for a lay person.
Wenn einer einer Nonne buhlerischer Weise entweder an ihr Kleid oder an ihre Brust ohne ihre Erlaubniss fasst, sei das doppelt so busspflichtig, wie wir vorhin über eine Laienperson bestimmten.
If someone seizes a nun lustfully either by her clothing or by her breast without her permission, let that be twice as liable to compensation as we determined before concerning a lay person.

note.label: cites
note.quote: Note too that Af 18 (lewd approaches to nuns) and 26 (under-age rape) actually cite 11, 11:2 (equivalent for laity/adult)

note.quote: §13 sets the fine for touching a laywoman's breast at 5 shillings.
